cells.note: Technicians at ZCHPC operate Sen4Stat to produce national crop type maps and maize acreage for the ministry and ZIMSTAT, on a system FAO built, a partner-built tool in government use (ruling 162). No source says the maps are published on a schedule, so not 4.
